links.title: Runbooks
links.tooltip: What each alert means and how to respond

panels.title: Calls, 5 min
panels.description: MCP tool calls per second for the selected tools.

panels.title: Error rate, 5 min
panels.description: Server-side failures per call. Red above 5%, the MCP errors alert level. Server-side failures are server errors plus tool failures the server caused (error_code backend_unavailable or not_configured).

panels.title: p95 latency, 5 min
panels.description: p95 of tool calls. Red above the MCP slow alert threshold.

panels.title: Empty-result rate, 1 h
panels.description: Share of successful retrieval calls that returned nothing, vector and graph tools together: the silent failure of a deterministic tool.

panels.title: Query tokens, 24 h
panels.description: Tokens the MCP server sent to the embedding model for search queries in 24 hours. Shown as tokens, not dollars: a search costs a small fraction of a cent.

panels.title: Calls by tool family
panels.description: Calls per second, stacked by family: search (vector_search), documents (fetch_evidence, get_document_context, list_documents, list_sources) and graph. Per-tool figures are in Per-tool summary.

panels.title: Failures by kind
panels.description: Share of calls that failed, by kind. Server-side failures (server errors, and tool failures with error_code backend_unavailable or not_configured) count toward the MCP errors alert (5% line). Caller or deployment failures do not: a bad argument, a feature not turned on, an empty index. Refused calls broke the tool's schema or a policy. Per-tool shares are in Per-tool summary.

panels.title: Latency distribution
panels.description: Tool call duration over time. An exemplar dot opens that exact call's trace in Tempo.

panels.title: Per-tool summary
panels.description: One row per tool over the dashboard's range: calls, the share that failed server-side (the MCP errors alert counts these: server errors and error_code backend_unavailable or not_configured), the share that failed for a caller or deployment reason (a bad argument, a feature not turned on, an empty index), p95 latency, and the share of retrieval calls that returned nothing (- for tools that return no result list). Sorted by calls.

targets.expr: (sum by (tool) (increase(harborrag_mcp_tool_calls_total{tool=~"$tool",tenant=~"$tenant",deployment_environment=~"$env",status=~"error|tool_error",error_code=~"|backend_unavailable|not_configured"}[$__range])) or sum by (tool) (increase(harborrag_mcp_tool_calls_total{tool=~"$tool",tenant=~"$tenant",deployment_environment=~"$env"}[$__range])) * 0) / sum by (tool) (increase(harborrag_mcp_tool_calls_total{tool=~"$tool",tenant=~"$tenant",deployment_environment=~"$env"}[$__range]))

(sum by (tool) (increase(harborrag_mcp_tool_calls_total{tool=~"$tool",tenant=~"$tenant",deployment_environment=~"$env",status="tool_error",error_code!~"|backend_unavailable|not_configured"}[$__range])) or sum by (tool) (increase(harborrag_mcp_tool_calls_total{tool=~"$tool",tenant=~"$tenant",deployment_environment=~"$env"}[$__range])) * 0) / sum by (tool) (increase(harborrag_mcp_tool_calls_total{tool=~"$tool",tenant=~"$tenant",deployment_environment=~"$env"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Empty-result rate by tool
panels.description: Share of successful retrieval calls that returned no result. A subgraph with no relations counts as empty.

panels.title: Mean time per retrieval step
panels.description: Mean seconds per vector_search step from span metrics. Means add up; p95s do not. Graph tools have their own band below.

panels.title: Auth failures by reason
panels.description: Requests refused for their bearer token, per interval; a client may retry each refusal. A spike of rejected_token: check key revocations.

panels.title: Graph calls by tool
panels.description: Calls per second to the graph tools: node resolution, triplet, subgraph and path search.

panels.title: Graph p95 by tool
panels.description: p95 per graph tool. Each call is a few graph-store queries, so this is the store's latency as callers see it; deeper max_depth and larger max_nodes cost more.

panels.title: Graph results per call
panels.description: Mean results per successful call: candidates for resolve_graph_nodes, triplets, paths, and relations for a subgraph. Falling to 0 after an ingestion: check the graph projection.

panels.title: Incomplete answers by reason
panels.description: Successful graph calls whose answer is incomplete, per interval and reason code: max_nodes, max_depth, max_paths, edge_limit or candidate_limit mean a limit cut it short (the caller can narrow the query); projection_truncated means the store capped the traversal.

panels.title: Stale or unpublished candidates dropped
panels.description: Candidates a retrieval tool dropped, graph or vector, because their document has a newer version (stale) or is not yet published. A steady stream after an ingestion means the graph projection lags Postgres.

panels.title: Slowest and failed calls, last hour
panels.description: Tool calls that failed or took over a second. A row opens its trace.
